title: Who might reach you — plain, not shorthand.
plain: These are patterns, not named people. We do not have their inboxes. The welcome is already public: the feed they are reading, and eco.primal@pm.me. Do not write to an IP.

letters.name: The Paris morning reader
letters.where: France, on OVH, about 9 in the morning Paris time
letters.why_them: This is the closest thing we have to a person who might write back. They did not scan WordPress. They checked whether the site was a modern JavaScript app, found it was not, and kept reading the news feed anyway. They tried the other table (nestgate) once and left it. They wanted the papers, not the chair.
letters.what_a_reach_would_look_like: They come back on another morning and open a run of pages with coffee, not a clock. Or a star, a crate download, a note to eco.primal@pm.me, a comment on an issue. None of that has happened yet.
letters.do: Keep the feed fresh in the morning. That is the door they already use.

letters.name: The one still in the chair
letters.why_them: Everyone else from the old three either packed up or went quiet. This one stayed. They read in sessions: a few hours of real looking, then a long quiet floor, then looking again. A little WordPress poke is mixed in, but most of what they get is actual pages. They are the empiricist. If anyone in that old group is studying a paper, it is them.
letters.what_we_cannot_see: Which paper. The free analytics do not split paths inside the main site finely enough to name the essay.
letters.do: Watch for another reading burst. Do not chase them. They are already in the room.

letters.name: The one who asked for science
letters.why_them: Almost everyone else asked for files that are not ours. This one asked for /science/. That is a reader looking for the work, not a hole in the fence.
letters.do: If they return, they will return to the science shelf. That page is the handshake.

letters.name: The irregular hours
letters.where: Britain, and a softer echo in Brazil and Turkey
letters.why_them: Their timing does not look like a machine block. No repeating 345. No lockstep. That shape is how people and newsrooms move. We do not have a face, only the weather.
letters.do: Count them as possible humans. Do not invent a letter until a path or a note appears.

letters.name: The one who kept the books
letters.why_them: They walked through the side door one day, then sat with the library and did not come back to the door. Quiet, steady, still here. A reader who found the papers. Less likely to write first than Paris.
letters.do: Leave the library where it is. They already chose it.

not_a_reach: Belgium and the Netherlands are still looking for WordPress leftovers. Japan is a health check that learned to rest. Those are not people to invite. Volume is not interest.
welcome: eco.primal@pm.me · https://sporeprint.primals.eco/contact/ · the beacon they already poll. No direct contact has arrived yet. The reorganization was them changing how they look, not them saying hello.
